question: An ideal projectile is fired with velocity 10 m/s at an angle of 60° with the horizontal. Its velocity at the highest point is:
explanation: At peak, vertical velocity v_y = 0. Only horizontal velocity remains: v_x = u cos 60° = 10 × (1/2) = 5.0 m/s. | Hint: At highest point, only horizontal component u cosθ survives.

question: Preeti reached the metro station and found that the escalator was not working. She walked up the stationary escalator in time t1. On other days, if she remains stationary on the moving escalator, then she takes time t2 to reach the top. The time taken by her to walk up on the moving escalator will be
explanation: Distances equal: v1 t1 = v2 t2 = (v1+v2) t -> t = t1 t2/(t1+t2).

question: A bus is moving with a speed of 10 ms^-1 on a straight road. A scooterist wishes to overtake the bus in 100 s. If the bus is at a distance of 1 km from the scooterist, with what speed should the scooterist chase the bus?
explanation: Relative gap 1000 m closed in 100 s -> relative speed 10 m/s -> 10 + 10 = 20 m/s.

question: Two vectors A and B have equal magnitude |A| = |B| = 10 units. If |A + B| = 10√3, then |A - B| is:
explanation: |A + B|² + |A - B|² = 2(|A|² + |B|²) ⇒ (10√3)² + |A - B|² = 2(100 + 100) = 400 ⇒ 300 + |A - B|² = 400 ⇒ |A - B| = √100 = 10. | Hint: Use parallelogram identity: |A+B|² + |A-B|² = 2(A² + B²).

question: A particle moving in a circle of radius R with uniform speed takes a time T to complete one revolution. If this particle were projected with the same speed at an angle θ to the horizontal, the maximum height attained equals 4R. The angle of projection θ is:
explanation: Speed v = 2π R / T. Max height H = v² sin²θ / (2g) = 4R ⇒ (4π² R² / T²) sin²θ = 8g R ⇒ sin²θ = 2g T² / (π² R) ⇒ θ = sin⁻¹[ √(2g T² / (π² R)) ]. | Hint: Equate orbital speed v = 2πR/T and projectile height H = v²sin²θ/2g.

question: When an object is shot from the bottom of a smooth inclined plane at 60° to the horizontal, the ratio of time of flight to the time to reach highest point is:
explanation: In uniform gravitational field with symmetric projectile motion, total time of flight T is exactly double the time to reach maximum height t_up: T / t_up = 2 : 1. | Hint: Time of ascent equals time of descent.

question: A body of mass 10 kg is projected at an angle of 45° with the horizontal. The change in momentum between the point of projection and the point of return is (u = 20 m/s):
explanation: Horizontal momentum is conserved (Δp_x = 0). Vertical momentum changes from +m u sinθ to -m u sinθ: Δp_y = -2 m u sin 45° = -2(10)(20)(1/√2) = -200√2 kg·m/s. | Hint: Δp = 2 m u sinθ downwards.
